title: Install #4502 adapters: full native replay saves 100 scalar allowance per orientation
body:
This closes the whole **ideal native-word integration and prefix-envelope check** left open by #4502. It adds no new local saving: #4502's four 766 → 666 replacements are installed into the complete THREE-base forward/backward programs, with a guarded installer, complete generated NATIVE.json and exact retained-event index map.

| Complete native word | Original scalar allowance | Rewritten | Saving |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Forward | 158,120 | 158,020 | 100 |
| Backward | 158,168 | 158,068 | 100 |

Fresh exact replay covers all 632 independent persistent inputs plus the original arbitrary owned C input in each orientation. All 408 helpers are restored in logical coordinates; C exits zero. The complete paid profile remains `{1:2487, 2:713, 3:232, 4:102, 5:28}`: 3,562 calls, rank mass 5,157. No additional field or non-scalar event. Every original non-scalar event has an exact new-index mapping.

Global ideal prefix maxima are unchanged: forward `(row l1, coefficient, numerator, denominator) = (457,32,32,32)`, backward `(169,5,21,64)`. The verifier executes both retained literal and prefix interpreter loops from authenticated source functions. Full-word omission controls reject missing borrowed-input restoration and dirty-target subtraction; installer controls reject stale windows, wrong charts and hidden paid events. Registered replay, committed-byte checks and isolated optimized Git-free export replay pass. Standard-library Python only; Windows tested, Linux execution unavailable.

```sh
python3 -I -O -B research/native-splice-replay/verify.py
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/native-splice-replay
```

**No new κ**, rounded induction, measured speedup, all-size compiler or physical phase-recipe regeneration is claimed. Unchanged global prefix maxima do not alone establish the rounded budget. Existing phase-event payloads/order are retained, but downstream receipts must consume the explicit index map. The canonical input is used as a chart/profile reference; its original cleanup-generation metadata is not rewritten. Consume NATIVE.json or the guarded installer rather than regenerate the old word from those old metadata arrays. The selected frontier is unchanged.

Credit #4502 for borrowed adapters, #4499 for exact gauges, #4494 for source windows/rank compilation and #4489 for the owned sum. Retain zxv's native reconstruction, Jacob Alan Sussman's mixed-target work, Cinna Davis's native/padding/query/retiming lineage and all source contributors. ATTRIBUTION.md records exact predecessor heads, retained interpreter reuse, MathProof restoration/feedback precedents and incomplete overlap coverage. Main was refreshed before submission and remained 2a13eb1827784206202db90e5dc8327cf8a250db. Substantial OpenAI assistance; Apache-2.0.
